project: Directional organelle-dynamics platform (organellomics; Hickey/Nazarov/Smertenko Plant Physiol 2023) — vertical #2 MITOCHONDRION
design_note: Directional score = biogenesis module score - degradation(mitophagy) module score, plus a SELECTIVE degradation sub-score built only from the mito-selective receptor genes (Atg32/Atg33). Strategic point: unlike peroxisome pexophagy (Arabidopsis has NO ATG36 ortholog, selective score empty), mitophagy HAS a genuine selective receptor (Atg32), so the SELECTIVE degradation arm is populated and testable here — closing the weak arm.

biogenesis.GO:0045040: protein insertion into mitochondrial outer membrane
biogenesis.GO:0045039: protein insertion into mitochondrial inner membrane
biogenesis.GO:0045041: protein import into mitochondrial intermembrane space (MIA)
biogenesis.GO:0160203: protein import into IMS via disulfide relay (MIA)

degradation.GO:0006914: macroautophagy (bulk - flags shared core autophagy machinery)

resolver_services.gene_resolution: mygene.info via genes-ontologies MCP (query_genes; scopes=symbol,alias; species=559292; SGD systematic + Swiss-Prot returned)
resolver_services.go_membership: QuickGO get_go_annotations (genes-ontologies MCP); per-gene distinct GO IDs intersected with the seed term set to CONFIRM membership rather than hand-assign

selective_arm_design.contrast_with_peroxisome: Peroxisome vertical: Arabidopsis has NO ATG36 ortholog, so its selective degradation score was empty (weak arm). Mitochondrion vertical: Atg32 is a bona fide, conserved-in-fungi selective mitophagy receptor, so degradation_selective is populated and can be validated — demonstrating the scorer's degradation arm becomes trustworthy when a real receptor exists.

collision_and_qc_flags.SSC1_alias_collision: query 'SSC1' also matched PMR1 (S000003135) as an alias; chose the record whose symbol==SSC1 (YJR045C / S000003806).
collision_and_qc_flags.MIA40_ERV1_go: QuickGO distinct_go_ids for MIA40/ERV1 did not carry the coarse import terms; membership confirmed via GO:0045041 / GO:0160203 (IMS disulfide-relay import).
collision_and_qc_flags.membership_confirmation: 41/43 genes carried >=1 seed GO term directly in QuickGO; the 2 exceptions (MIA40, ERV1) confirmed via the MIA-specific IMS-import terms.

fission_sharing_note: DNM1 (YLL001W) and FIS1 (YIL065C) are SHARED with peroxisome division machinery — the same fission dynamin/receptor divides both organelles. They are flagged in 'notes' as shared_with_peroxisome_division and are NOT double-counted as autophagy (shared_with_bulk_autophagy=False). MDV1/CAF4 are mitochondria-specific fission adaptors.

dropped_genes.reason: HAP2/3/4/5 (CCAAT-binding complex) are lineage-specific TRANSCRIPTIONAL REGULATORS of respiratory/mitochondrial biogenesis, not conserved structural machinery. Consistent with the peroxisome-vertical rule to keep conserved machinery and drop diverging regulators; kept out of the biogenesis module.

mrna_proxy_caveat: Transcript abundance is a proxy. A positive net_direction is 'consistent with a shift toward biogenesis'; elevated degradation/selective scores are 'consistent with a shift toward clearance (mitophagy)'. These are NOT organelle turnover rates.
literature_verification_note: All PMIDs verified via pubmed MCP get_article_metadata (first author + year + title checked). Two originally-drafted PMIDs were REJECTED on verification and removed: 19749676 (a dermatology paper, not Okamoto/Atg32) and 23392225 (mammalian FIP200/Atg16L1, not yeast Atg11); replaced with 19619494 (Okamoto 2009 Atg32) and 29370687 (Fukuda/Kanki yeast mitophagy review).

positive_controls_validation_results.test_method: Welch's unequal-variance two-sample t-test (equal_var=False); Cohen d and one-sided Mann-Whitney U reported alongside. NOTE: an earlier draft mislabeled a pooled Student's t as Welch; these are the true Welch values.

biogenesis_control_GSE301747.verdict: PASS (significant at alpha=0.05; equal n so Welch==pooled t)

mitophagy_control_GSE149016.verdict: DIRECTION PASS (every growing replicate below every rapamycin replicate; d=5.5 total, 8.3 selective), but formal significance NOT reached: Welch p=0.058-0.073 does not clear alpha=0.05 and MWU floor is 0.10 at n=2 vs 3. Underpowered; treat as directional support, not a significant test.
